name: arc-gx
description: Arc GX - desktop overlay + companion panel (Electron + Rust N-API + ONNX)
author: Arc GX

scripts.build:renderer: npm run build -w @arcgx/renderer-desktop && npm run build -w @arcgx/renderer-overlay
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:workers && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.dev:renderer: concurrently -n desktop,overlay -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @arcgx/renderer-desktop" "npm run dev -w @arcgx/renderer-overlay"
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:renderer && electron apps/main/dist/index.js
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && npm run verificar:pacote
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/main/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/renderer/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/renderer/overlay/tsconfig.json
scripts.data:all: npm run data:ingest -- --out dados && npm run data:publish -- --src dados --out build/release
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/*/dist apps/*/release packages/*/dist packages/shared/dist apps/renderer/*/dist
